name: feature-pipeline
description: Полный TDD-пайплайн разработки фичи (Red-Green-Refactor) от roadmap до готового результата. Координатор управляет через TaskCreate/TaskUpdate, каждый шаг — отдельный delegate_task. Каждая функция: tests-impl (Red) → implement (Green) → verify → refactor → commit. Phase-gate e2e на границах этапов. В финале: полная верификация, smoke/e2e-тесты, документация, отчёт.
author: FAN Team

changelog.3.2.0: TDD cycle reordered to Red-Green-Refactor: tests-impl (Red) → implement (Green) → verify → refactor → commit. Refactor step added between verify and commit. Phase-gate e2e at stage boundaries (Smoke-критерий этапа + E2E-сценарий этапа). New anti-patterns: Test-After, refactor without green tests. Aligned with feature-roadmap v1.3.0.
changelog.3.1.0: Pipeline Mode: working artifacts (development-plan.md, development-log.md, phase-status.json). Integration with FAN Orchestrator /pipeline command. Auto-update hooks on TaskCreate/TaskUpdate. Mandatory commit policy (conventional-commits, per-phase/per-function/manual). Function limit increased to 30 per stage. State recovery after session restart.
